description: Will buyer agents choose my x402 API? Buyer-agent models choose between your offer and its real Bazaar rivals for up to three tasks, across buyer personas and list positions: your win rate with confidence intervals (position-corrected too), why you lost, and the proof arm (whether a Fair Offer block or an attested sample lifts your pick rate). One task is the single-task panel; two or three tasks, or edits=true, is the full panel, which also tests up to three truthful edits on the same trials. Price: one task $0.25; two or three tasks, or edits=true, $1.00, in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call; the 402 states the one price of what the arguments ask for. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges that price to it. Failed calls aren't charged.
